item.title: High school hoops schedules altered
item.description: Staff Reports With area schools closed this week in the aftermath of Winter Storm Fern, the local Lincoln Parish hoops schedules have also seen some postponements and possible cancellations. Ruston High School’s boys and girls varsity teams were scheduled to play district games at Ouachita, but those have been postponed until a later date. item.title: Man charged in Ruston domestic case
